identity.philosophy: Fusion over Imitation. Emotion First. Content is King.

theme.name: The Digital Atelier
theme.description: A gallery-like experience where appliances are presented as art pieces. High contrast, generous whitespace, and sophisticated typography.

headings.usage: Hero titles, Section headers, Product names

accents.usage: Technical specs, Price tags, AI data points

accent.name: Burnished Copper
accent.usage: Call to actions (subtle), Sale tags, Highlights

rules: Never use pure white (#FFFFFF) for page background. Use #FAFAFA for warmth.
AI elements must have a 'glass' effect, not solid colors.

grids.product_list: Masonry or Staggered Grid (Avoid uniform rows)

buttons.style: Sharp edges or Pill-shaped (Choose one, stick to it)

cards.style: Flat with 1px border, No shadow by default

hero_background.alt: Modern luxury kitchen with stainless steel appliances

motion.scroll: Use Lenis for smooth scrolling if possible
motion.micro_interactions: Buttons should have magnetic pull or subtle glow on hover

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. INSTALL FONTS: Add 'Playfair Display' and 'Manrope' via Google Fonts in index.html or CSS.
2. IMPLEMENT THEME: Update tailwind.config.js with the 'Obsidian' and 'Platinum' colors.
3. BUILD HERO: Create a full-screen hero section using the 'hero_background' image with a dark overlay (bg-black/40) and white serif text.
4. AI AGENTS: Design the AI Chat Widget as a floating glass card (backdrop-blur-xl) with the 'ai_abstract' image as a subtle animated background.
5. PRODUCT CARDS: Do not use standard borders. Use a large amount of whitespace and a subtle gray background (#F4F4F5) for the image container.
6. NAVIGATION: Keep the navbar transparent with a blur effect. Use a serif font for the logo 'Aditya Retail'.
7. TESTING: Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI Slop': No generic gradients, no centered text blocks without purpose.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
